sql:
SELECT 
    c.state,
    SUM(b.bname) as total_account_balance
FROM bank b
JOIN customer c ON b.branch_ID = c.branch_ID
WHERE c.credit_score > 100
GROUP BY b.state
HAVING SUM(b.bname) > 0

FROM

    Organization_Contact_Individuals oc
    ON i.individual_id = oc.individual_id

    Individuals i

        WHERE o.organization_id = oc.organization_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.individual_id
ORDER BY 
    i.last_name
LIMIT 1
